title: Chia seed wrap
creator: ann_aknows
statusNote: The creator gives no amounts. The ≈ amounts are estimates from the video.
steps: Mix the chia seeds with the water and a pinch of salt and let them gel for 10–15 minutes.
Spread thinly into a round in a non-stick pan over medium-low heat.
Cook until it holds together, flip and cook the other side.
Fill and fold like a tortilla.
